description: A shadow priest who walks Duskhollow's boundary between life and death, draining the living to restore the wounded. Their dark tome whispers with the voices of the almost-departed.
icon_hint: dark purple tome radiating shadow tendrils entwined with faint healing light
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy dark channeler shadow healer class in a necrotic crypt. Bone-fragment border wrapped in shadow tendrils with faint green healing wisps at corners. Dark grey-green crypt stone center with shadow threads and soft green healing light pulses. Small dark tome with healing glow at bottom. Color palette: dark crypt green, shadow purple, faint healing green. No characters, no text.
